commands.command:
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
for k in db/app-control/need_show_off_sensing db/tv-viewer/reinforce_off_sensing_time memory/tv-viewer/cancel_reinforce_off_sensing_popup db/tv-viewer/force_el_sensing/count; do
 echo "VCONF_KEY $k"
 vconftool get "$k"
 key_status=$?
 echo "VCONF_GET_EXIT $key_status"
done
cat /proc/uptime
date -u
